name: Extract
description: Extract is a Rust-powered ELT and data pipeline platform. From Claude, you can sign in or create an Extract account through browser OAuth; discover connectors; create and configure sources, destinations, and connections; select streams; request source sample data; inspect pipeline status and run history; diagnose failed runs; and trigger manual runs after confirmation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Extract to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Extract to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.extract.to/mcp-account. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Extract MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extract lists 21 MCP tools, including account_summary, create_connection, create_destination, create_sample_data, create_source, diagnose_connection, get_connection, get_connector, get_sample_data, get_source_stream, list_connection_runs, and list_connections.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Extract?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Extract in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Extract requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Extract is developed by Extract.to. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
